theme: visual checks on CISI photographs: Lothal elephant sealings against seal M-895 (C-0004), and the closing sign on Shot A's large seals (C-0001 layout and direction rivals)
question: Do the CISI plates show the same four signs and different animals and seals on Lothal L-161 to L-170 and Mohenjo-daro M-895, and do the seals whose legends end in 001, 595, 679 or 820 show the closing sign set apart, squeezed or in a reversed legend, compared with matched seals ending in other signs?
outcome: Check 1: P1 pass, the same four signs in order (U, bracketed strokes, two small marks, heart enclosing a V) on M-895 and every readable sealing, by both readers; P2 unresolved, elephant (trunk with crossing tusk) on the sealings by both readers at low to moderate confidence, M-895 read as a unicorn by the first reader and unidentifiable by the second, no elephant feature on M-895; P3 pass on carved form, bracket sign 0.38-0.45 of the line on six sealings against 0.54 on M-895 (second reader 37-41% against 53-54%), while the impressed face (23.4 mm, range 21.1-24.2) matches M-895's 23.3 mm. C-0004 0.5 to 0.6 by the card's rules. Shot A prospective 1 met (face 23.4 mm within 19.9-35.4). Check 2: 29 set seals, 22 with images; 14 support the grade reading, 0 layout, 0 direction, 8 undecided (3 end in a single short stroke for 001, 5 damage, crowding or illegible); comparison 27 of 29 grade, 0 rival; Fisher p = 1; read blind 12 of 18; all 7 viewable 820 seals support the grade reading. Shot A prospective 3 passes; C-0001 0.21 to 0.24 by the frozen rule for prospective 1.
challenge: AI readings of printed halftones without specialist confirmation; CISI 1 scan about 100 dpi; Lipi crops carry CISI captions, so ten seals were read knowing their identity; seven set seals (three ending in 820) have no held photograph; the final sign 001 is a short stroke that the size rule cannot classify; the readers disagree on the animal of M-895; scale for the sealings rests on the volumes' 2:1 policy with a 10% spread between calibration seals.
remedy: Protocol and amendments hashed before viewing; population rebuilt with Shot A's own code without touching its access log; comparison seals fixed by rule before viewing; caption-stripped composites under random labels with time-stamped readings before unblinding; an independent second reader with renamed images for Check 1; decisions computed by script from the logged readings.
retry_when: A specialist reads M-895's field and the Lothal sealings on the CISI photographs or the objects; photographs of M-1701, M-1720, M-1761, M-1764, M-1989, H-1708 and DHR-16412 become available (CISI 3 or excavation reports); or a rule for closing signs that are small by form, such as the single stroke 001, is fixed before viewing. Do not rerun Check 2 on the same Lipi crops with the same rules.
